description: Localisation des fontaines publiques à Sceaux is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Sceaux. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Equipement / Services. Its keywords are fontaine. The portal shows 21 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
